blocking_findings.statement: The execute-evidenced-v4 arm in bounded_p1.rs accepts the state directory path from an unauthenticated caller-provided contract file. This caller-controlled production registry location allows an attacker to bypass the exclusive directory creation check and launch a SECOND_ATTEMPT.

If recorder.flush() fails during execute_evidenced_bounded_p1_once, the error is propagated immediately, bypassing attempt.terminalize_evidenced(). This live terminal DAG edge omission leaves the package in an unterminated state, leading to AMBIGUOUS_ACCOUNTING.

summary: REJECT. Found caller-controlled registry location in bounded_p1 (execute-evidenced-v4) enabling SECOND_ATTEMPT, and terminal DAG edge omission in execute_evidenced_bounded_p1_once causing AMBIGUOUS_ACCOUNTING.
